name: chatwork-bridge
description: Add 32 local-work MCP tools for project inspection, guarded edits, recoverable jobs, Apple MPS, read-only Git, and native macOS UI control, with explicit stale-tool-subset recovery guidance.

interface.shortDescription: 32 local-work tools with guarded writes and recoverable jobs.
interface.longDescription: Chatwork Bridge 0.4.4 gives ChatGPT or Codex a 32-tool local execution layer: workspace snapshots, explicit full-read/project-write access diagnostics, precise scan truncation reasons, project-scoped edits and sandboxed commands, validated patches, read-only Git inspection, persistent supervised jobs with efficient waits, pressure-aware Apple MPS runtime checks, and native macOS Accessibility actions. A conversation may initially load only a small task-selected subset of schemas; the Bridge explicitly tells the model not to mistake that for a read-only server and to rediscover apply_patch/write_file, run_command, start_job, or capability_catalog when the task needs them. Synchronous commands are capped below the Secure MCP Tunnel response deadline so long work cannot poison the channel; training, downloads, builds, and benchmarks use recoverable jobs. Its stable runtime lives in Application Support, mutating calls are audited and marked for confirmation, and macOS commands report process-sandbox status.
defaultPrompt: Resume this local project with workspace_snapshot, make focused changes, and verify them.
Inspect my Python and MPS runtime, then start and monitor this training job safely.
Diagnose Chatwork Bridge after a timeout and recover any running jobs.
If only read or discovery tools appear at first, rediscover apply_patch, run_command, start_job, or capability_catalog before concluding the Bridge is read-only.
